acceptance.requirement: Every dispatchable node freezes the seven mandatory classification fields plus routingPolicyVersion, validates every published enum, and binds modelRoutingEvidenceDigest.

One versioned machine policy and deterministic compiler emit the complete stage profile schema, including allowed pool, default and selected profile, routing authority/input digest, reason, permissions, Skill digests, and capability digest.
Root is exactly Luna/low/normal and cannot choose profiles; DAG defaults to Terra/max, uses Sol/xhigh only for specified conflict/complexity evidence, and reserves Sol/max for a frontier exception.

Test-contract and fresh read-only behavior-verification phases use the Sol/high, Terra/max, Sol/xhigh ladder selected from verification and contract evidence; neither phase gains implementation authority.
Code bounded, complex, high-risk, and frontier routes are respectively Luna/max, Sol/high, Terra/max, and Sol/xhigh; Sol/medium and Terra/xhigh are forbidden.

Prescribed and bounded-composition UI use Sol/low; layout and interaction judgment use Sol/medium; system-design disputes stop implementation and route to a fresh read-only Sol/high or Sol/xhigh adjudicator.
UX local, path, and system verification use Sol/medium, Sol/high, and Sol/xhigh in a fresh read-only context without implementation or redesign authority.
Documentation uses only Luna/high or Luna/max after behavior and UX prerequisites; cleanup green is issued only by the deterministic machine verifier and no LLM cleanup profile exists.
An implementer reaches candidate-green in one attempt with an unchanged frozen test tree; its self-test receipt cannot sign independent behavior or UX acceptance.

Only a structured blocker matching the frozen policy can reclassify a route; implementation failures, rework count, balance, telemetry, or human preference cannot change correctness routing, and unavailable capability fails closed.

Every acceptance-group member has independent classification, routing, contract, lease, candidate, self-test and fresh verification receipts; continuity never inherits another member's profile, permissions, or verifier context.
Legacy issue-implementer/reviewer aliases, node-local model/effort, implementationProfile/reviewProfile, and the fixed-Sol v1 shared install have no authority or fallback.
